mission: Investigate autonomic nervous system regulation and ageing to identify and validate candidate physiological markers of resilience and deterioration.
research_questions: Do dynamic autonomic responses add predictive information beyond resting HRV and chronological age?
Are autonomic recovery dynamics associated with age-related functional decline?
Which candidate signals replicate across independent cohorts and devices?
guardrails: Do not equate HRV with biological age or longevity.
No clinical claims without independent validation.
Record dataset provenance, limitations and negative findings.
No patient-identifiable data or unauthorized access.
